# Joint_Kinematics

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Source native joint-coordinate cycles and pelvis/scapula geometry. Anatomical conversions are documented in the equations.

- [hip_x.tsv](hip_x.tsv) — Reference hip position along the direction of progression, in metres.
- [hip_z.tsv](hip_z.tsv) — Reference hip height in metres.
- [joint_q.tsv](joint_q.tsv) — Reference joint-coordinate cycles in radians. Use the documented anatomical conversion before comparing them with angle plots in degrees.
- [left_joint_correction_rad.tsv](left_joint_correction_rad.tsv) — Saved left-side assembly correction in radians used with the assumed mirrored hindlimb reference; this is not a measured left-side recording.
- [pelvis_angle.tsv](pelvis_angle.tsv) — Reference pelvis orientation in radians.
- [pelvis_angular_velocity.tsv](pelvis_angular_velocity.tsv) — Reference pelvis angular velocity in rad/s.
- [scapula_angle.tsv](scapula_angle.tsv) — Reference scapula orientation in radians.
- [scapula_angle_by_side.tsv](scapula_angle_by_side.tsv) — Side-specific scapula reference orientations in radians.
- [shoulder_z.tsv](shoulder_z.tsv) — Reference shoulder height in metres.
- [shoulder_z_by_side.tsv](shoulder_z_by_side.tsv) — Side-specific reference shoulder heights in metres.
